name: @cornertasks/backend-aws
description: CornerTasks BYO-AWS backend (SAM + TypeScript). Deploy this to your own AWS account; the maintainer does not host a shared backend.

scripts.deploy:dev: STAGE=${STAGE:-dev} npm run package && sam deploy --stack-name cornertasks-${STAGE:-dev} --parameter-overrides Stage=${STAGE:-dev} --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --resolve-s3 --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset && npm run print-outputs
scripts.deploy:prod: STAGE=prod npm run package && sam deploy --stack-name cornertasks-prod --parameter-overrides Stage=prod --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --resolve-s3 --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset && STAGE=prod npm run print-outputs
